resources.string: Only your confirmed WhatsApp self-chat can send agent requests. Start requests with [Codex:]. Hans replies with [Hans:]. Linked WhatsApp devices are trusted; no other chat or messenger is allowed.
Channel unavailable. No requests will run.
Unconfirmed handoffs: %1$d. They will not be repeated automatically.
Choose your actual self-chat. Names alone do not prove identity. Only a recent WhatsApp conversation with usable Android identity metadata can be selected.

No eligible conversation received. Send a short [Codex:] message to your own WhatsApp self-chat from a linked device, keep WhatsApp in the background on this phone, then try again. If WhatsApp sends no notification, this channel cannot receive the request.

Confirm that “%1$s” is your own WhatsApp self-chat, not another contact. Requests starting with [Codex:] can run in Hans using its existing permissions. All devices linked to this WhatsApp account are trusted. Confirming does not run earlier messages.
The conversation could not be confirmed. Receive a fresh self-chat notification and try again.
Incomplete agent message. Send it again as a short, complete text in your self-chat. Its preview has not been executed.
